items.question: How do the two principles mutually pervade each other through eternal abiding?
items.inference: mutual pervasion establishes eternal co-abiding of the pair
uncertainties: exact referents of tayoḥ depend on prior context
items.plain_english: Likewise, their mutual pervasion of eternity and abiding belongs to those two.
